description: Determine the programming language associated with each supplied file path purely from its file-name extension. The handler receives a list of path strings and emits, for every path in order, one line pairing the original path with the detected language name (or a neutral 'unknown' marker when the extension is not recognised or absent). Extension matching is case-insensitive and independent of any directory components in the path.

SRC/MAIN.RS	rust
App.JS	javascript
Widget.JSX	javascript
Page.TSX	typescript
module.PY	python
Server.GO	go
Bean.JAVA	java
Engine.CXX	cpp
Node.HPP	cpp
